mentions.note: new member; drove down from Hereford, moving to Surbiton

photos.c: Left; Colin Blake hands over to Nigel Clarke in the 25X1 mile relay at Crystal Palace. You would not guess from this shot that Nigel is about to put in a 57.5 first lap to run 4.30 the hard way. Colin drove down from Hereford to get a run and we look forward to his company following a move to Surbiton.
